Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim number.
Q: That works. Can you tell me where the collision happened?
A: It was at an intersection in Pearland, Texas, a main road with a signal and a shopping center on the corner.
Q: What were you doing at the time?
A: I was driving my own car and turning left across the lanes to get into the shopping center.
Q: Did you have a green light or a left arrow?
A: I had a green light, but the arrow had already turned off, so I was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic.
Q: What happened next?
A: A vehicle coming from the opposite direction hit the front passenger side of my car as I was completing the turn. I
felt a hard jolt and my head snapped forward and back.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before it reached you?
A: Not clearly. I looked, saw headlights, and thought I had time. It was closer than I expected.
Q: Were you able to drive your car afterward?
A: It was drivable at first, but I had it towed because the front end was damaged.
Q: Have you sought medical attention for any injuries?
A: Yes, I went to a clinic the same day. They diagnosed a neck strain and told me to rest and use ice and a soft collar
for a few days.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Yes, my neck is stiff, especially in the morning, and turning my head to check mirrors hurts.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add?
A: Only that I was trying to follow the rules of the road and I didn't expect the other driver to come through so fast.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
</page>
